climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A sparkling wine from Brescia province, in Lombardy, made by the traditional method on hills between Lake Iseo and Brescia. Its rules allow Chardonnay, Pinot Nero, Pinot Bianco and Erbamat.
